citygml_synthetic — DRIVE japan op

• Data kinds: none → any (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.citygml_synthetic(n: 'int' = 4, *, origin: 'tuple[float, float]' = (35.6716, 139.765), spacing: 'float' = 30.0, size: 'float' = 12.0, heights: 'Sequence[float] | None' = None, ground_z: 'float' = 0.0, omit_measured_height: 'Iterable[int]' = (), use_lod0_footprint: 'bool' = False, ns_building: 'str' = 'http://www.opengis.net/citygml/building/2.0') -> 'str' (to call the implementation directly, import driveplateau; driveplateau.citygml_synthetic(n: 'int' = 4, *, origin: 'tuple[float, float]' = (35.6716, 139.765), spacing: 'float' = 30.0, size: 'float' = 12.0, heights: 'Sequence[float] | None' = None, ground_z: 'float' = 0.0, omit_measured_height: 'Iterable[int]' = (), use_lod0_footprint: 'bool' = False, ns_building: 'str' = 'http://www.opengis.net/citygml/building/2.0') -> 'str'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("citygml_synthetic"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Creates a minimal CityGML 2.0 string with the same structure as the real thing (for tests and demos).

Buildings are squares of size [m] placed along x at spacing [m] intervals, and for each building bldg:measuredHeight and bldg:lod1Solid > gml:Solid > gml:exterior > gml:CompositeSurface > gml:surfaceMember × 6 > gml:Polygon > gml:exterior > gml:LinearRing > gml:posList (bottom + 4 sides + top, in lat lon alt order) are written. The equirectangular approximation is linear, so a square made in local coordinates has area equal to size² when read back.

Args:

n: number of buildings (≥ 0).

origin: (lat, lon) [deg] of the centre of building 0.

spacing: spacing of building centres [m].

size: side of the square [m].

heights: height of each building [m]. If None, 10 + 5*i.

ground_z: elevation of the bottom face [m].

omit_measured_height: do not write measuredHeight for buildings at these indices.

use_lod0_footprint: if True, also write lod0FootPrint (bottom face only) before lod1Solid.

ns_building: bldg namespace URI (can be swapped for tests of other versions).

Returns:

A CityGML string that can be written out as UTF-8.

Raises:

ValueError: n negative, size/spacing non-positive, heights length mismatch or non-positive.
